race.description: Bet365 Tatura Cup Sat Nov 21 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: ROGUE WARRIOR (2) hopped over the border and finished fourth at Morphettville Parks just over 3 weeks ago on a heavy track, and his form through the winter has been sound. We think he needs a good track to show his best, and in this easier assignment on a firmer surface, he will be the one to beat. FROZEN TIDE (6) made up many lengths late when finishing runner-up by a neck at Murtoa last start, and he is facing a similar setup here. He handles any type of track conditions and can run another bold race. Each way. TIGER FOX (8) broke through for a well-deserved maiden win when leading all the way to cruise home by over 2 lengths at Bendigo 12 days ago. Keep safe. CROWN OF RUSSIA (1) has talent, and even though he will want further, he could have the last say fresh over a mile.
